mapper.insert: INSERT INTO locations (location_name, created_at, deleted_at, organization_id, addr_street1, addr_street2, city, state, country_code, postal_code, timezone) VALUES (#{locationName}, #{createdAt}, #{deletedAt}, #{organizationId}, #{address.addrStreet1}, #{address.addrStreet2}, #{address.city}, #{address.state}, #{address.countryCode}, #{address.postalCode}, #{address.timezone})
mapper.select: SELECT location_id FROM locations WHERE location_id = #{locationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO location_current_states (location_id, current_state, state_date) VALUES (#{locationId}, #{state}, #{stateDate})
mapper.select: SELECT location_id, location_name, created_at, deleted_at, organization_id, addr_street1, addr_street2, city, state, country_code, postal_code, timezone FROM locations WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY location_name, location_id

SELECT l.location_id, l.location_name, l.created_at, l.deleted_at, l.organization_id, l.addr_street1, l.addr_street2, l.city, l.state, l.country_code, l.postal_code, l.timezone FROM locations l JOIN user_locations ul ON ul.location_id = l.location_id WHERE ul.user_id = #{userId} AND l.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ul.end_date IS NULL OR ul.end_date > NOW()) ORDER BY ul.start_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE locations SET location_name = #{locationName}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, organization_id = #{organizationId}, addr_street1 = #{address.addrStreet1}, addr_street2 = #{address.addrStreet2}, city = #{address.city}, state = #{address.state}, country_code = #{address.countryCode}, postal_code = #{address.postalCode}, timezone = #{address.timezone} WHERE location_id = #{locationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
